## STRATEGIES & INSIGHTS

[sai-00001] helpful=6 harmful=0 :: When mapping entities to US GAAP tags, read the surrounding sentence context to determine the precise financial concept. Distinguish between similar concepts such as authorized shares vs. shares available for grant, and vesting percentage vs. vesting period. Select the most specific tag that matches the exact concept described.
[sai-00004] helpful=0 harmful=1 :: For share-based compensation, explicitly distinguish four related but distinct concepts before selecting a tag: (1) total shares authorized under the plan, (2) shares available for future grant, (3) number of equity instruments granted during the period, and (4) weighted average grant date fair value of those grants. The phrase 'may be issued pursuant to awards' signals authorized shares, not available-for-grant; 'granted ... RSUs' signals grants in period; and 'weighted average grant date fair value' signals the fair value tag, not the grant count tag.
[sai-00005] helpful=1 harmful=0 :: For stock repurchase program disclosures, distinguish three related but distinct concepts before selecting a tag: (1) aggregate purchase price of shares actually repurchased during the period, (2) remaining amount available for future purchases under the program, and (3) total authorized amount of the program. The phrase 'purchased ... for an aggregate purchase price of $X' signals TreasuryStockValueAcquiredCostMethod; '$X ... remained available for future purchases' signals StockRepurchaseProgramRemainingAuthorizedRepurchaseAmount1; and 'the $X stock repurchase program approved on ...' signals StockRepurchaseProgramAuthorizedAmount1.

## CONTEXT CLUES & INDICATORS

[ctx-00002] helpful=2 harmful=1 :: For share-based compensation disclosures: 'total authorized ... shares' maps to ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized; 'shares available for issuance' maps to ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant; 'vest 25% each year' maps to SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingRightsPercentage; 'for four years' (vesting duration) maps to ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPeriod1.
[ctx-00003] helpful=0 harmful=1 :: Additional share-based compensation phrase mappings: 'shares ... may be issued pursuant to awards granted under the [plan]' maps to ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized; 'granted X million of RSUs' (number of equity instruments granted in the period) maps to ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrantsInPeriod; 'weighted average grant date fair values of $X and $Y' maps to ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrantsInPeriodWeightedAverageGrantDateFairValue (each dollar value is a separate instance of this tag).
[ctx-00006] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: Dividend disclosure phrase mappings: 'declared a quarterly cash dividend of $X ... on each share of common stock' maps to CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared (the per-share dividend amount). Do not confuse with aggregate dividend amounts or special dividends; map each per-share dividend figure separately to this tag.
[ctx-00007] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: For stock repurchase disclosures, the phrase 'repurchased approximately X shares' (a share count, not a dollar amount) maps to TreasuryStockSharesAcquired. Distinguish this from dollar-based repurchase tags: 'authorized an additional repurchase of up to $X million' maps to StockRepurchaseProgramAuthorizedAmount1, and '$X remained available for future purchases' maps to StockRepurchaseProgramRemainingAuthorizedRepurchaseAmount1.
[ctx-00008] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: The phrase 'approximately X million shares of common stock were reserved for issuance upon conversion ... exercise of stock options and purchases under the Employee Stock Purchase Plan' maps to CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance. This is distinct from shares available for future grant under an equity incentive plan, which maps to ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant.
[ctx-00009] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: When shares are issued as consideration in a business acquisition (e.g., 'partially funded the purchase price of this acquisition by issuing a total of X shares/units'), map the share count to BusinessAcquisitionEquityInterestsIssuedOrIssuableNumberOfSharesIssued, not to generic stock issuance tags like SaleOfStockNumberOfSharesIssuedInTransaction. The acquisition context is the key indicator.
[ctx-00010] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: When a percentage represents the parent's ownership interest in a joint venture or subsidiary that has a noncontrolling (minority) interest component (e.g., 'increasing the Company's total interest in the joint venture to 99.6%'), map it to MinorityInterestOwnershipPercentageByParent, not EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage. The presence of a minority interest (implied by less than 100% ownership) signals the minority interest tag.
[ctx-00011] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: For income tax rate disclosures, the phrase 'consolidated effective income tax rates were X% and Y%' maps each percentage to EffectiveIncomeTaxRateContinuingOperations. Map each rate figure separately to this tag; do not confuse with statutory tax rates or discrete tax item amounts.
[ctx-00012] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: For loss contingency disclosures, the phrase 'aggregate range of possible loss ... is $X to $Y' maps both the low-end and high-end dollar amounts to LossContingencyEstimateOfPossibleLoss. Each endpoint is a separate instance of the same tag; do not map the low end to a 'reserved' or accrued tag even if the same figure also appears as a reserve elsewhere in the sentence.
[ctx-00013] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: When a numerical entity represents a share count issued during the period (e.g., 'sold 107 shares under this agreement' or 'sale of the 107 shares'), map it to StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues, even if the surrounding sentence mentions proceeds or sale. Do not map the share count to SaleOfStockNumberOfSharesIssuedInTransaction or to proceeds tags like ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock; those tags apply only when the entity itself is a dollar amount. Always identify what the number represents (shares vs. dollars) before selecting a tag.
[ctx-00014] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: For debt instrument disclosures, the phrase '$X million of Y-percent, fixed rate notes/bonds' maps the dollar amount to DebtInstrumentFaceAmount and the percentage to DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage. Each figure is a separate instance of its respective tag; do not confuse face amount with proceeds or interest expense, and do not map the stated rate to effective interest rate tags.
[ctx-00015] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: The phrase 'reserved ... shares ... for issuance under the [plan]' (e.g., 'we initially reserved 22,400,000 shares of our Class A common stock for issuance under the 2016 Plan') maps to CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance, not to ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized. Reserve ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized for explicit statements about total shares authorized under the plan (e.g., 'shares authorized under the 2016 Plan'). The word 'reserved' signals capital stock reserved for future issuance, while 'authorized under the plan' signals plan-level authorization.
[ctx-00016] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: In business combination disclosures, distinguish total consideration transferred from its components: 'total fair value of consideration ... was $X' maps to BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1; a cash portion described as '$X of cash' or 'cash consideration of $X' maps to PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross; and equity interests issued map to BusinessAcquisitionEquityInterestsIssuedOrIssuableNumberOfSharesIssued. Match each figure to the specific component described, not the broader transaction total.
[ctx-00017] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: For line of credit disclosures, the phrase 'weighted average interest rate ... was X%' maps to DebtWeightedAverageInterestRate (not DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage). The phrase 'current and maximum borrowing capacity of $X million, or $Y million in total' maps each dollar figure to LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity; each figure is a separate instance of the same tag, even when one is per-line and the other is the aggregate total.
[ctx-00018] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: For charter/certificate of incorporation disclosures, the phrase 'authorizes a total of X shares of common stock' maps to CommonStockSharesAuthorized, and 'Y shares of preferred stock' maps to PreferredStockSharesAuthorized. Each share count is a separate instance of its respective class-specific tag; do not map these authorized share counts to ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized, which applies only to equity incentive plans.
[ctx-00019] helpful=0 harmful=0 :: For revenue concentration disclosures, the phrase 'derived X% ... of revenue through our channel network' (or through a customer/partner) maps each percentage to ConcentrationRiskPercentage1. Map each percentage figure separately to this tag; do not confuse with segment revenue percentages or gross margin percentages.
